requirements.title: Pre-transfer file positioning depends on access method
requirements.definition: Before data transfer, file positioning depends on whether access is sequential, direct, or stream.

pending.pretransfer-positioning-access-method-de: Use separate sequential, direct, and stream future fixtures with distinct records/positions; assert only the positioning behavior specified for the selected access method.

requirements.title: Sequential input keeps a current record or advances to the next record
requirements.definition: For sequential input, an existing current record leaves the file position unchanged; otherwise the file is positioned at the beginning of the next record and that record becomes current.

pending.sequential-input-current-record-position: Leave a current record with nonadvancing input, then continue reading distinctive remaining characters into nonblank sentinels and expect no repositioning away from that record.
pending.sequential-input-next-record-becomes-cur: Write two distinct records, ensure no current record before input, then read into sentinels and expect the next record's values.

requirements.title: Sequential input shall not occur without a next record or after output on the current record
requirements.definition: For sequential input, input shall not occur if there is no next record or if there is a current record and the last data transfer statement accessing the file performed output.

pending.sequential-input-prohibited-with-no-next: Future source-control negative reaches terminal/no-next-record state before attempting input; diagnostic observation is deferred because this unit does not require a processor rejection and portable execution can observe only data-transfer status rules.
pending.sequential-input-prohibited-after-curren: Future source-control negative leaves a current record by output and then attempts input on it; no portable diagnostic is required by this unit, so tests must not compare IOMSG or processor-specific status numbers.

requirements.title: A file containing an endfile record shall not be positioned after it before data transfer
requirements.definition: If a file contains an endfile record, it shall not be positioned after the endfile record prior to data transfer.

pending.no-data-transfer-position-after-endfile-: Future source-control negative writes an endfile record, positions after it, and attempts data transfer; this rule supplies the prohibition but no portable rejection oracle or IOMSG text comparison.

requirements.title: REWIND or BACKSPACE may reposition a file containing an endfile record
requirements.definition: A REWIND or BACKSPACE statement may be used to reposition a file that contains an endfile record.

pending.rewind-may-reposition-before-endfile: Write records followed by ENDFILE, execute REWIND, then read the first record into nondefault sentinels under registered rules.
pending.backspace-may-reposition-before-endfile: Write records followed by ENDFILE, execute BACKSPACE where permitted, then read the preceding known record into nondefault sentinels; assert data, not physical marker representation.

requirements.title: Sequential output keeps or creates the current last record
requirements.definition: For sequential output, an existing current record leaves the file position unchanged and that record becomes the last record; otherwise a new next record is created, becomes the last and current record, and the file is positioned at its beginning.

pending.sequential-output-current-record-positio: Establish a current record with nonadvancing output and write distinctive continuation text; read back the record to show output continued there rather than creating an intervening record.
pending.sequential-output-current-record-becomes: Create following records, reposition to an earlier current record under registered rules, output distinctive data, then read back to confirm later records are not retained as following records.
pending.sequential-output-creates-new-next-last-: With no current record after known records, write a distinctive new record and read back the final sequence; assert record data and order only.

requirements.title: Direct access positions at the REC= record before data transfer
requirements.definition: For direct access, the file is positioned at the beginning of the record specified by the REC= specifier, and that record becomes current.

pending.direct-access-position-at-rec-record: Create direct-access records with distinct REC= numbers and read a selected REC= into nondefault sentinels; expect the selected record data, not storage representation.
pending.direct-access-rec-record-becomes-current: After positioning with REC=, perform a continuation or subsequent operation whose registered semantics depend on the current record; assert only the selected record effect.

requirements.title: Stream access positions before POS= storage unit or leaves position unchanged without POS=
requirements.definition: For stream access, the file is positioned immediately before the file storage unit specified by POS=; if no POS= is present, the file position is not changed.

pending.stream-access-position-before-pos-unit: Write distinct stream values, then read with POS= at a previously known positive position into nondefault sentinels and expect the value at that position.
pending.stream-access-no-pos-position-unchanged: After a stream transfer that establishes a defined position, perform another transfer without POS= and observe continuation through distinctive adjacent values; avoid asserting byte counts.

accounting.rationale: Defines access-method dependence for pre-transfer positioning.
Sequential input positioning effects and prohibitions are split.
Endfile positioning prohibition and REWIND/BACKSPACE permission are split.
Permission to reposition using REWIND or BACKSPACE.
Sequential output positioning and truncation effects.
Stream POS= and no-POS positioning effects.
Cross-reference to child data transfer positioning rules in 12.6.4.8; no local obligation is introduced.
